The package verifier tests extremizers k=1..9, all binary words through length 11, and independent two-round EF responses on short pairs. All quantifiers and boundary cases (empty words, singletons, one-letter alphabets) are accounted for.

value.rationale: The new exact invariant is the minimum length of any model with a fixed rank-two theory; the result computes it word-by-word and achieves a universal sharp worst case k(k+2), with an explicit extremizing word for every alphabet size. This provides a rigorous finite cutoff for classification and exhaustive rank-two search, notably stronger than nonsharp generic existence bounds. Its structural active-letter-gap proof is nontrivial and natural to finite model theory, not an arbitrary numerical slice.
